line: Manage your portal preferences and access advanced administration.
prefsLine: Choose how information appears in the loyalty portal.
langHint: Changes interface labels. Your written content stays as entered.
themeHint: Auto follows your device. Member app styling is in Card & app.
relabelTitle: Changes the label, not the amount
relabelExample: For example, 100 {{from}} will display as 100 {{to}}. No exchange rate is applied and stored amounts stay the same.
adminHint: Open Full admin for settings outside the loyalty portal.
adminAccess: Available options depend on your access.
helpLine: Use the guide for setup steps and explanations.
confirmLine: Amounts will keep the same number. Only the currency label will change.
confirmHint: No conversion will be performed. Check that {{currency}} is the label you intend to use.
currencyPermission: Only an owner or a manager can change the currency.
draftLine: Your current programme stays in place until you review and apply these changes.
previewHint: This preview uses your draft settings. No real points are added.
optional: Start simple. Add more when you need it.
